title: Requests throws 'Value Error: too many values to unpack (expected 2)'
author: weather_dev
body:
## Bug Report

When making a GET request with specific params, requests throws a `ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)`.

### Code to reproduce

```python
import os
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import requests
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv()
API_KEY = os.getenv("API_KEY")
start_timestamp = 1630000000
end_timestamp = 1630003600

# Found example on StackOverflow (stackoverflow.com/questions/12345678)
# Calling api.weather endpoint
url = "https://api.weather.com/v1/history"
session = requests.Session()
p = requests.PreparedRequest()
p.prepare(url=url)

response = requests.get(url, params=[("key", API_KEY, "extra")])
```

### Traceback

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "test.py", line 18, in <module>
    response = requests.get(url, params=[("key", API_KEY, "extra")])
  File "/usr/src/app/weather_provider/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/api.py", line 75, in get
    return request('get', url, params=params, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/app/weather_provider/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/api.py", line 61, in request
    return session.request(method=method, url=url, **kwargs)
  File "/usr/src/app/weather_provider/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 528, in request
    p.prepare(
  File "/usr/src/app/weather_provider/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/models.py", line 318, in prepare
    self.prepare_url(url, params)
  File "/usr/src/app/weather_provider/.venv/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/models.py", line 437, in prepare_url
    for k, vs in to_key_val_list(params):
ValueError: too many values to unpack (expected 2)
```

Tested with requests v2.26.0 on Python 3.9 on Ubuntu 20.04.
